name: Navapur
description: Navapur is an interactive 3D Indian city that runs in the browser. The identity is built on a torana archway framing a skyline and a rising sun: a doorway into a place that is already living its own life.

gold.role: Primary brand colour: the arch, skyline and wordmark rules

mint.role: Secondary accent: the sun, live indicators, links

sage.role: Muted supporting text on light fields

wordmark.family: Trebuchet MS, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

devanagari.family: Nirmala UI, Noto Sans Devanagari, system-ui, sans-serif

clearSpace: Keep clear space equal to the height of the wordmark's N on every side of any lockup; for the mark alone, keep 96 units of the 512 grid.

assets.title: Navapur logo mark
assets.description: The primary mark: a gold torana arch with a finial, framing four skyline blocks and a mint rising sun, on a deep green rounded field.
assets.usage: Headers, the in-game brand block, app listings and anywhere the name appears nearby. Never recolour or rotate.

assets.title: Navapur horizontal lockup
assets.description: The mark beside the NAVAPUR wordmark, the Devanagari नवापुर and the tagline, on a transparent field.
assets.accessibleLabel: Navapur — a city, a thousand stories
assets.usage: Site headers, README banners, press kits and slide title cards. Preferred lockup wherever width allows.

assets.title: Navapur stacked lockup
assets.description: The mark above the wordmark, Devanagari and tagline, centred.
assets.accessibleLabel: Navapur — a city, a thousand stories
assets.usage: Splash screens, posters, square social posts and merchandise.

assets.title: Navapur single-colour mark
assets.description: The mark reduced to one colour, inheriting currentColor.
assets.usage: Watermarks, one-colour print, embroidery, Safari mask icons and any surface that cannot carry the full palette.

assets.title: Navapur mark — flat
assets.description: The mark drawn without gradients or clip paths, for rasterisers and manufacturing workflows that do not support them.
assets.usage: Source for PNG exports, screen printing and any renderer with limited SVG support.

assets.title: Navapur wordmark
assets.description: The NAVAPUR wordmark with its rule and tagline, without the arch mark.
assets.usage: Where the arch mark already appears close by, or in tight horizontal bands.

assets.title: Navapur favicon
assets.description: A thickened, simplified arch and three skyline blocks that survive rendering at 16 px.
assets.usage: Browser tabs and bookmarks. Do not use above 64 px; use the full mark instead.

assets.title: Navapur app icon
assets.description: The maskable installed-app icon: the mark inset to 72 percent inside a full-bleed field so any platform mask can crop it safely.
assets.usage: Web app manifest, home-screen install and store listings. Exported to icon-192.png, icon-512.png and apple-touch-icon.png.

assets.title: Navapur social card
assets.description: A 1200 by 630 dusk skyline with the mark, wordmark and a three-line promise, for link previews.
assets.accessibleLabel: Navapur, an interactive 3D Indian city experience
assets.usage: og:image and twitter:image. Regenerate whenever the tagline or mark changes.

assets.title: Navapur interface icon system
assets.description: Fifty-eight interface icons on a 24 unit grid with a 1.5 stroke, drawn in currentColor, each with an accessible label, description, keywords, category and usage note.
assets.usage: Import from src/ui/icons.ts inside the app; use /brand/icons-sprite.svg or /brand/icons.json elsewhere. Browse them at /brand/icons.html.
